law: The QTFF is an ideal format for the exchange of digital media between devices, applications, and operating systems, because you can use it to describe almost any media structure.
QuickTime provides a number of high-level functions that you can use to create and manipulate QuickTime files, without requiring you to understand the actual file format.
Use this documentation to create QuickTime files beyond the basic types.
If you are writing an application that parses QuickTime files, you should recognize that there may be non-movie data in the files.
